title: Simple Crafting
description: Auto craft if you have enough item.
body:
A plugin that helps you automatically craft items, supports menus, permissions

**Command:**
- /scraft : Open the custom crafting recipe list
- /scraft create : open the custom recipe creation GUI

**Permission:**
- simplecrafting.command.use: allow to use /scraft (default: op)
- simplecrafting.command.create: allow to use /scraft create (default: op)
- And permission to craft item (default: everyone)
